questions.stem: Why is soft iron used as the core of an electromagnet rather than steel?

options.text: Soft iron is a stronger magnet than steel
Soft iron loses its magnetism quickly when the current is switched off
Soft iron is cheaper than steel
Steel cannot be magnetised at all

questions.explanation: Soft iron is used because it is easily magnetised and quickly demagnetised when the current is switched off. Steel retains its magnetism, which would prevent the electromagnet from being switched off effectively.

questions.stem: What is one key advantage of an electromagnet over a permanent magnet?

options.text: Electromagnets can be switched on and off

questions.explanation: A key advantage of electromagnets is that they can be switched on and off by controlling the current. This makes them useful in applications like scrapyard cranes, where you need to pick up and release magnetic materials.
